characters.franchise: Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku
characters.identityProse: Kaoruko Waguri from The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity, a sincere Kikyo Girls Academy student with long blackish-purple hair, large blue eyes and a warm, expressive smile. Braids and work aprons belong to the selected daily outfit rather than a permanent identity.

outfits.name: 千鸟女子高校名媛水手制服
outfits.prose: her prestigious Kikyo Girls' High School uniform: an elegant white-and-navy sailor blazer with a crisp pleated white collar, a navy necktie, a pleated navy skirt below the knees, white knee-high socks, and polished dark loafers

outfits.name: 蛋糕工坊甜品烘焙围裙
outfits.prose: her warm bakery work attire: a soft cafe-brown cooking apron worn over a yellow pastel knit sweater and long floral skirt, with flour smudges on her cheek and a small chef's bandana tying back her blackish-purple braids

outfits.name: 夏祭牵牛花浅蓝浴衣
outfits.prose: a festive summer festival yukata in sky blue patterned with blooming morning glories, cinched with a yellow obi sash, with a goldfish pouch as a festival accessory and her blackish-purple braids pinned with floral clips

outfits.name: 甜粉草莓蕾丝内衣
outfits.prose: a delightfully sweet pastel pink and ivory lace lingerie set: a balconette bra framing her full soft breasts with tiny strawberry ribbon bows, matching scalloped lace hipster panties, and a sheer pink chiffon peignoir

outfits.name: 纯净圣洁胴体
outfits.prose: her completely bare, sweet and voluptuous body with golden-blonde hair spilling loose over her shoulders, full rounded breasts with soft peach-pink nipples, a gentle tummy, and smooth radiant porcelain skin

outfits.name: 糖霜白花蕾丝蓬蓬婚纱
outfits.prose: a dreamy pure white lace princess wedding gown with a puffy layered skirt like whipped cream, a white flower bridal veil, and a bouquet decorated with fresh strawberries and sugar-frosted lilies

outfits.name: 烘焙体验格纹衬衫
outfits.prose: a cream-and-brown checked long-sleeved shirt, dark straight trousers, a mint-green cotton apron and padded oven mitts

outfits.name: 草莓红开衫便装
outfits.prose: a strawberry-red cardigan over a cream collared blouse, a navy calf-length skirt and a narrow cream hairband
